text:
Trump calls for Ilhan Omar's resignation as Minnesota congresswoman's ‘real name’ is questioned amid federal investigation
Trump cited the new report and reiterated that Ilhan Omar had been sworn into Congress under a “fake name” and asserted that she should “immediately resign.”
Shirin Gupta
President Donald Trump on Thursday called on Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar to resign from Congress after citing a Fox News Digital report that claimed her legal name differs from the one she has publicly used.
However, Omar’s office strongly denied the allegation, calling it “completely false.”
In a post on Truth Social, Trump cited the new report and reiterated that Omar had been sworn into Congress under a “fake name” and asserted that she should “immediately resign.” He also urged House Speaker Mike Johnson to consider her congressional seat vacant.
(This story is being updated)
